title: RegenerateChangeSummary.v1
description: Regenerate a summary with a new prompt version or model: creates a new SummaryRecord (new summaryId); the previous one never changes (RF-058). Sent by the evaluation pipeline of ms-change-summary after approving the prompt or model (DEC-25).
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.4 catalog CMD-02; RF-054, RF-058; US-05.2.3. Producer: ms-change-summary. Consumers: ms-change-summary. Channel: SQS global-ms-change-summary-commands (sent by the evaluation pipeline of ms-change-summary, DEC-25). Ordering/partition key: summaryKey. Idempotency key: summaryKey + promptVersion + modelId. Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC (DISENO 4.4). Template metadata only; stays in the home region (not replicated to cells). Response event(s): ChangeSummaryReady.v1 (new summaryId; the previous record does not change).
x-channel: SQS global-ms-change-summary-commands (sent by the evaluation pipeline of ms-change-summary, DEC-25)

summaryKey.description: SummaryKey value object (templateId, from, to, locale), DISENO S2 (b).

modelId.description: Provider model id to use (pinned, no alias, RF-054).

reason.description: Why the evaluation pipeline regenerates: an approved prompt version or a new pinned model (RF-054, RF-058).

x-responseEvents: ChangeSummaryReady.v1 (new summaryId; the previous record does not change)
